title: Laboratory requisition instructions
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Synthetic test document. It follows the structure of the real document type but is not an actual letter from any organisation.
summary_en: Instructions for blood tests: do not eat for 12 hours before, bring the requisition and health card; the lab is open Monday to Saturday from 7:30 a.m.
text:
Riverdale Family Health Team (fictional)
Laboratory test instructions
Your doctor has ordered blood tests. Please take the attached requisition to any community laboratory.
- Do not eat or drink anything except water for 12 hours before the test (fasting).
- Bring the requisition form and your Ontario health card.
- The lab at 555 Broadview Avenue (fictional) is open Monday to Saturday from 7:30 a.m. No appointment is needed.
Results are sent to your doctor within 3 to 5 days.
